feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 26 October 2026 5:38am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds, then gales (and perhaps severe gales for a time) later.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, soon backing SE 6 or 7, veering S or SSW early afternoon. Increasing 7 or gale 8 through the evening, perhaps occasionally severe gale 9 early night, then veering SW overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough, then rough or very rough for a time later.


##Weather)##

Rain at times.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
